crossRefs.note: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you…
Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language…
a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.
“Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He…
But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,
Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says Yahweh. “It is a mighty nation. It is an…
For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel;
not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you…
In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They…

translations.web: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.
translations.bsb: You will no longer see the insolent, a people whose speech is unintelligible, who stammer in a language you cannot understand.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that thou canst not comprehend, of a strange tongue that thou canst not understand.
